milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to the polished granite pillar and be able to see it. The target is the center of the polished granite pillar at spawn-relative [6, 2, 5]. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished blackstone with a pickaxe causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player does not start with any polished_blackstone in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has directly verifies the player obtained the resource.
